---
title: "admet"
output: html_document
---

```{R}
admetlab_m5 <- read.csv("m5_admetlab.csv")
admetlab_m5$Molecule <- "m5"
admetlab_10176710 <- read.csv("10176710_admetlab.csv")
admetlab_10176710$Molecule <- "10176710"
admetlab_348154 <- read.csv("348154_admetlab.csv")
admetlab_348154$Molecule <- "348154"
admetlab_10394 <- read.csv("10394_admetlab.csv")
admetlab_10394$Molecule <- "10394"

all_admetlab <- rbind(admetlab_m5, admetlab_10176710, admetlab_348154, admetlab_10394)

swissadme_m5 <- read.csv("m5_swissadme.csv")
swissadme_10176710 <- read.csv("10176710_swissadme.csv")
swissadme_348154 <- read.csv("348154_swissadme.csv")
swissadme_10394 <- read.csv("10394_swissadme.csv")


all_swissadme <- rbind(swissadme_m5, swissadme_10176710, swissadme_348154, swissadme_10394)

```

### BBB

```{R}
bbb_data <- merge(
  all_admetlab[, c("Molecule", "BBB")],
  all_swissadme[, c("Molecule", "BBB.permeant")],
  by = "Molecule"
)

colnames(bbb_data) <- c("Molecule", "ADMETlab", "SwissADME")

print(bbb_data)
```

### CYP inhibition

```{R}
cyp1a2_data <- merge(
  all_admetlab[, c("Molecule", "CYP1A2.inh")],
  all_swissadme[, c("Molecule", "CYP1A2.inhibitor")],
  by = "Molecule"
)

colnames(cyp1a2_data) <- c("Molecule", "ADMETlab", "SwissADME")

print(cyp1a2_data)
```

```{R}
cyp_admet <- all_admetlab[, c(
  "Molecule",
  "CYP1A2.inh",
  "CYP2C19.inh",
  "CYP2C9.inh",
  "CYP2D6.inh",
  "CYP3A4.inh"
)]

cyp_swiss <- all_swissadme[, c(
  "Molecule",
  "CYP1A2.inhibitor",
  "CYP2C19.inhibitor",
  "CYP2C9.inhibitor",
  "CYP2D6.inhibitor",
  "CYP3A4.inhibitor"
)]

# garantir mesma ordem
cyp_swiss <- cyp_swiss[match(cyp_admet$Molecule, cyp_swiss$Molecule), ]

cyp_data <- data.frame(
  Molecule = rep(cyp_admet$Molecule, each = 5),
  CYP = rep(c("CYP1A2", "CYP2C19", "CYP2C9", "CYP2D6", "CYP3A4"),
            times = nrow(cyp_admet)),
  ADMETlab = c(
    t(cyp_admet[, -1])
  ),
  SwissADME = c(
    t(cyp_swiss[, -1])
  )
)

print(cyp_data)
```
